fit.sheet: Intersil CA3260 data sheet FN1266 Rev. 7.00 (December 2009), at V+ = 15 V, V– = 0 (±7.5 V)
fit.figure: Electrical characteristics at V+ = 15 V, V− = 0: AOL 320 kV/V typ; at ±7.5 V: unity-gain crossover 4 MHz, slew rate 10 V/µs, follower overshoot 10 % (CL 25 pF, RL 2 kΩ); total supply current 9 mA with outputs at mid-supply; VOM+ 13.3 V typ at 10 kΩ, within 10 mV of each rail unloaded
fit.method: A small macromodel (scripts/fit_models.py opamp_card, D-162): a tanh transconductance stage limited to 10 µA into C1 sets the slew rate, gm the unity-gain crossing and R1 the open-loop gain; a second pole gives the phase margin; diode clamps and an output resistance set the swing; the supply current is drawn from the rails. CMOS output: clamps 35 mV from each rail and an output resistance of 1.28 kΩ (VOM+ 1.7 V short at 1.33 mA). Phase margin 65.6° fitted so a follower at the sheet's load overshoots 10 %; internal slew 16.4 V/µs so the output slews at the sheet's 10 V/µs into 2 kΩ (the 1.28 kΩ output divides it).
fit.note: Input bias, offset, noise, common-mode limits and the output's current limit are not modelled: the input stage is ideal (1 TΩ). The real output stage is nonlinear (22 mA short-circuit source current at 15 V); a fixed 1.28 kΩ is right near 1 mA and pessimistic for heavy loads.
